title: Secret key or password left in the app
why: Anyone who downloads the app can read it and use your account or paid service.
fix: Remove it from the build, load it from a server or environment at runtime, and replace (rotate) the key.

title: Debug or developer mode left on
why: Debug mode can show developer tools, extra logs and slower code to real users.
fix: Turn debug options off in the production build settings.

title: Test or local address left in
why: The app may try to reach your own computer or a test server, so features break for users.
fix: Point the production build at the real server address.

title: Developer-only file shipped
why: These files are only needed while building and can reveal settings or the original source code.
fix: Exclude them in your build or packaging configuration.

title: Very large file
why: Large files make the download slower and may have been added by mistake.
fix: Check it is really needed, compress it, or load it on demand.

title: Unfinished work note
why: TODO and FIXME notes often point to features that are not finished.
fix: Review each note and finish or remove it before release.
